observations: Photo 0 shows a used automotive gearbox with a silver casing and a central input shaft.
Photo 1 shows the input side of the gearbox with a large input shaft splined hub.
Photo 2 shows the gearbox from a different angle, showing the casing and mounting points.
The gearbox is surrounded by other car parts and tools in a workshop setting.
There is visible dirt and some rust on the casing in photos 0 and 2.

claims.claim: deals on all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: The seller's business scope cannot be confirmed from photos of a single item.

risks.risk: The gearbox may be seized or have internal mechanical failure.
risks.proof: A video of the gearbox being turned by hand or a test run.

risks.risk: The input shaft may be damaged or stripped.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the input shaft splines.

risks.risk: The output shaft may be bent or have excessive wear.
risks.proof: A photo of the output shaft.

risks.risk: The gearbox may be missing internal components like the input shaft bearing.
risks.proof: A photo of the internal components or a bearing test.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the gearbox being turned by hand to check for smooth operation.
Photo of the input shaft splines.
Photo of the internal components or the input shaft bearing.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
